## Rule

Fixed 10x10 one-hot inputs over colors `{0,5}`. Preserve color `5`; recolor zero cells from the 4-neighbor count of adjacent zero cells:

- `0` zero-neighbors -> color `3`
- `>=2` zero-neighbors -> color `1`
- `1` zero-neighbor -> color `1` if that lone zero-neighbor touches any zero cell with `>=2` zero-neighbors, else color `2`

Canonical recipe: `Research_Archive/notes/recipe-task369-zero-adjacency-label.md`.

## Algorithm sketch

For each cell, build `z = (input == 0)` and `five = (input == 5)`. Compute `adj0 = z * conv4(z)`. Then:

- `color1 = adj0 >= 2`
- `color2 = (adj0 == 1) & ~conv4(color1)`
- `color3 = (adj0 == 0) & z`
- `color5 = five`

The ONNX implementation is one-hot channel output, padded back to the standard 30x30 canvas.
